messages:
maya: heads-up — the diff view sparklines in scorecard compare are showing identical peaks for two variants even though sample-level metrics differ. noticed this on the eval-run from tonight.

kevin: hmm can you paste the query/filter you used? I can't repro on local.

maya: filter: `model:rwv-v1-512, dataset:human_eval_sanity, seed:2026-03-18`

maya: also screenshot: https://redwood.test/s/shot123 (will DM if needed)

olga: that's likely the rollup window. If snapshots were taken at different ingest windows they might be bucketed the same.

maya: possible — but when I click drilldown for the sample modal the per-sample values show clear divergence. so the sparkline agg looks wrong.

kevin: can you dump the aggregator output? e.g. from the console devtools network -> `/api/scorecard/rollups` response

maya: pasted response snippet:
```
{"metric":"sac@1","buckets":[{"t":0,"v":0.92},{"t":300,"v":0.92}],"variant":"A"}
{"metric":"sac@1","buckets":[{"t":0,"v":0.57},{"t":300,"v":0.57}],"variant":"B"}
```

maya: but UI shows both as 0.92 on sparkline in compare view.

rahul: weird. maybe frontend is mapping by metric label and reusing the same color/series id when metric keys clash? could be a reduce key collision in the rollup normalizer.

liz: @kevin @olga tagging since this touches rollup code + sparkline component. can someone bisect to the last deploy? last deploy at 1953208000

kevin: pulling logs now. quick check: the frontend rolled new "compact-sparkline" which changed series keying to `metric + model` — but our backend rollup uses `metric + variant` — if variant empty/null could cause both to collapse.

olga: good point. payloads show `variant` sometimes `null` for legacy evals. UI assumed non-null. adding guard.

maya: repro steps I used:
1) open console -> scorecard compare
2) pick two variants
3) toggle "align on sample count"
4) observe sparklines

kevin: created PR #4021 to add `variant || 'unknown'` when keying series and to fallback to sample-level values if buckets length < 3. will add unit test.

maya: thanks. can we also add a quick e2e with a serialised rollup where variant=null so we don't regress again?

kevin: yes I'll add a cypress test and roll it behind feature-flag.

eval-bot: deploy started to staging at 1953216000 :rocket:

maya: moving to verify in staging after deploy. will ping with screenshots.

liz: thx team. short follow-up: make a note in the changelog under "scorecard/sparkline" and drop a one-line note in release notes.

maya: done — added a note in #eng-releases.

maya: staging looks good, sparklines diverge now as expected. closing on my side :thumbsup:
